mapper.select: SELECT id, slug, title, category_id, annotation, occasion, year, featured, status, sort FROM lots ORDER BY sort
SELECT id, slug, title, category_id, annotation, occasion, year, featured, status, sort FROM lots WHERE status = 'published' AND featured = 1 ORDER BY sort LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, slug, title, category_id, annotation, seo_text, meta_title, meta_description, occasion, year, fabric_notes, client_name, featured, status, sort FROM lots WHERE slug = #{slug}
SELECT id, slug, title, category_id, annotation, seo_text, meta_title, meta_description, occasion, year, fabric_notes, client_name, featured, status, sort FROM lots WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT l.id, l.slug, l.title, l.category_id, l.annotation, l.occasion, l.year, l.featured, l.status, l.sort FROM lots l WHERE l.status = 'published'
AND l.category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = #{categorySlug})
AND l.id IN ( SELECT lt.lot_id FROM lot_tags lt JOIN tags t ON t.id = lt.tag_id WHERE t.name = #{tag} )
AND ( l.title LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR l.annotation LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR l.seo_text LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' )
ORDER BY l.sort
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lots WHERE status = 'published' AND category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT id, lot_id, path_thumb, path_full, alt, caption, sort FROM lot_images WHERE lot_id = #{lotId} ORDER BY sort
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lot_images (lot_id, path_thumb, path_full, alt, caption, sort) VALUES (#{lotId}, #{pathThumb}, #{pathFull}, #{alt}, #{caption}, #{sort})
mapper.select: SELECT t.name FROM tags t JOIN lot_tags lt ON lt.tag_id = t.id WHERE lt.lot_id = #{lotId} ORDER BY t.name
